title: cardboard-pack1
description: This texture pack replaces jungle wood with cardboard, giving the world a unique box-like look. Netherite is also retextured into cardboard, making even the strongest gear look lightweight and funny.
body:
Cardboard Texture Pack gives Minecraft a playful cardboard aesthetic for selected elements:

Jungle trees are replaced with cardboard textures
All netherite tools and armor now have cardboard textures
Everything else remains the default Minecraft look
Works perfectly with Minecraft 1.21.1
